name: Melat Kiros
description: Melat Kiros is a candidate for CO-1 who has embodied the social and environmental justice values that Sunrise Movement and her campaign are built upon. In 2023, Melat wrote an [open letter to US law firms](https://medium.com/@melatakiros/dear-us-law-firms-77ec63e838af) about concerns in discerning between anti-semitism and quesitoning Israel's legitimacy. Her refusal to take down the letter resulted in her being fired, but more importantly, demonstrates her integrity and commitment to her values. One of Melat's core policy positions is to remove money from politics. Thanks to grassroots campaigning, Melat challenged and beat the 30 year incumbent, Diana Degette, who had received over $1.5 million in campaign contributions from the fossil fuel industry, while Melat has continued refused to accept any corporate PAC money at all. Melat Kiros a candidate who embodies the same socialeconomic justice values as Sunrise Movement and the Green New Deal through not only her stated values, but also her continued actions.
